messages:
mara: Quick ping — customer's onboarding sample app fails: REST create route succeeds but JS SDK returns 422. Error message hints at missing required field. Anyone seen param/shape drift between REST and SDK?

aj: Can you paste both requests? My money's on naming mismatch (timeout vs timeout_ms) or SDK dropping unknown fields like model_variant.

mara: Repro below. REST (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"name":"test","model":"gpt-open-3","model_variant":"v2","timeout":30}'
```
JS SDK (422):
```js
// app uses @redwood/sdk v1.4.2
client.routes.create({ name: 'test', model: 'gpt-open-3', timeout_ms: 30000 })
// autocomplete has no model_variant option, and passing extra fields gets dropped
```

aj: Yep — SDK schema shows timeout_ms only and no model_variant. Backend validation expects model_variant and "timeout" in seconds. SDK also strips unknown keys by design, so model_variant never reaches server.

sam: Another issue: our client wrapper enables auto-retry for 4xx/5xx by default. For non-idempotent POST this caused duplicate route creation for this customer after an infra 500.

mara: Server logs show duplicates: 
```
[2025-01-02T18:12:01Z] POST /v1/routes idempotency: - header missing - req r_abc123
[2025-01-02T18:12:02Z] POST /v1/routes req r_def456 (same payload)
```
No Idempotency-Key sent and retry retried once leading to two creations.

leo: Short-term mitigation: have caller set Idempotency-Key and disable autoRetry in client config. Example:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ autoRetry: false, headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': uuid() } })
client.routes.create(payload)
```
That stops duplicates until we ship a proper fix.

devex-bot: Ticket created DEVEX-4823: "js-sdk: expose model_variant, accept timeout and timeout_ms, and change retry defaults for non-idempotent methods" — https://tickets.redwood/DEVEX-4823 :robot_face:

aj: I'll pick up the SDK change. Plan: 1) Add model_variant field to route create shape (allow string|enum), 2) Accept both timeout (seconds) and timeout_ms (convert ms->s), 3) Do not drop unknown fields by default for top-level create payloads (or at least warn), 4) Adjust retry middleware so autoRetry=true only for idempotent methods; POST requires explicit idempotency opt-in.

mara: I'll attach a minimal repro + sample app and confirm exact sdk version to DEVEX-4823. Also adding a simple integration test comparing REST payload to SDK-serialized payload to catch regressions.

sam: From ops perspective, we should also add a short-term proxy rule to log missing Idempotency-Key on POSTs and emit an alert for duplicates across a small time window.

mara: Good call. I'll follow up with SRE. Thanks everyone, leaving updates in the ticket. :thumbsup:
